judge-scores.note: Read-model-entries counts [sheet tick node] tuples; score-entries-total counts individual judge scores. Judge calls in the install smokes and the blocker-triage calibration used the offline evaluate-single path (no events). The scores present here came from Part B (results/judge-persistence.md): tier-1 judges ATTACHED to the summarizer-judged sheet's leaf, fired by the :evaluation/on-node-execution-completed processor, written by the :evaluation/record-judge-score commands — the only path that emits :judge/score-emitted.

auto-classified-executions.evidence: Tree profiles are the read model that execution classification lands in; zero profile events of any kind exist in the store.

consolidations.note: Consolidation requests fired from the threshold trigger during the install smokes' repeated leaf executions (results/learning-diagnosis.md). Root cause of their original orphaning (proven): the consuming processor (:ontology/consolidate-on-request, ontology/core/consolidator.clj) was required by no production or consumer namespace, so it was never registered. Fixed consumer-side 2026-10-17 (router-loop.system requires the namespace + pins :ontology-consolidator-model): registry 34 -> 35. Ledger now fully answered: 8 requested — 2 completed (node-type leaf description v1, consolidation-wiring.md; node-instance [smoke-a summarize] description v1, consolidation-node-instance.md), 6 swept to :ontology/description-consolidation-failed (:caller-interrupted, attempts 0), 0 unanswered. Claim deltas remain 0 by design (node-type/node-instance targets take the body path; claim deltas are :tree-class-only, CC-5).

behavior-mints.note: All mints in the store come from seed-baseline-corpus! (E3 durable coding subbehaviors, command carries :provenance :human-authored) — bootstrap content, not runtime volitional minting or promotion of an execution pattern.

layer8.registry-note: The MCP Sheet Builder registers NO Grain commands or queries (grep of components/mcp-sheet-builder/src for defcommand/defquery is empty); it is a plain function API (connect, list-tools, generate-sheet, ...) required by router-loop.system for side-effect registration alongside the other components.
